cleared.check: Cycle 30 critic lead on the AccountChange arm of Tempo's rollback: after a reverted frame that moved value, does every balance return to its pre-frame word, for the balances the PoolManager settles against?
cleared.result: For native value the arm moves nothing: value transfers are refused by the node ('value transfer not allowed' on an eth_call with value 1 to settle, also with a balance override), so the native branch of _settle at src/PoolManager.sol:353-354 can only credit 0 and no PoolManager native balance exists to restore. The PoolManager has no CREATE, so the nonce half does not reach it. For the TIP-20 balances that sync and _settle read (src/PoolManager.sol:285-286, 357-360) and that take moves (src/PoolManager.sol:291-296, src/types/Currency.sol:60-73), a live harness at the PoolManager address showed a 1,000,000 unit pathUSD transfer inside a reverted frame fully undone (19,999,496,692 before and after, recipient 0), and the same transfer committed exactly in a returning frame. The binary lift of that arm is still not done, but the behaviour the PoolManager depends on is what the endpoint returns.

cleared.check: Upcoming forks: T14 (8 December 2026), T15 (target 15 December 2026, TIP-1166 configurable-account voucher signers) and T16 (target mid-January 2027): what changes for the PoolManager and funds inside it the day after.
cleared.result: T14 is already in the running v1.19.1 release, against which every vector and script set above ran, and its rules were rehearsed in cycle 29. TIP-1166 changes only who may sign vouchers for a TIP-20 channel reserve opened by the payer; the PoolManager calls only balanceOf and transfer on a currency (src/types/Currency.sol:60-73, 90-) and never opens a channel, so no PoolManager balance enters a channel. The T15 page states that no existing method, event or channelId formula changes. T16 has no published scope. F-135 already records the zone deposit forwarding that earlier cycles tied to T15.

leads.question: Does Arc publish, in a validator registry contract, consensus metadata or an operator page, which arc-node commit each block proposer runs, and is any proposer on 37812c61 or 8e8edb7a, whose source is unpublished?
leads.why: Every Arc test pins an endpoint build, not the build that produces blocks; headers and docs name none.

leadResults.answer: The method is arc_getVersion. web3_clientVersion answers 'arc/v1' on rpc.mainnet.arc.io, Geth/v10.0.0/drpc on arc.drpc.org and reth/v2.2.0-508cbdf on arc-rpc.publicnode.com, while arc_getVersion returned v0.8.6-rc1 at 37812c61, v0.8.6 at 8e8edb7a and v0.8.5 at 602eed3b in three of three samples each on 2026-11-27, so the three endpoints still answer three builds. No Arc page, explorer field or block header names the validators' build (extraData holds only the base fee). No tag newer than v0.8.6 exists and main's evm.rs is byte identical to cycle 29's copy, so frame_init, before_frame_init and check_blocklist_and_create_log have not changed in any public source. Which build the validators run stays unknown; a new low lead tracks it.

15 December 2026 is a target date only. crates/hardfork/src/lib.rs on tempo main returns None for T15's mainnet activation timestamp (lines 413, 440 and 467), and the T15 page says the testnet target is 8 December and the mainnet target 15 December, with timestamps set when the T15 release is published. No release past v1.19.1 exists.

No Tempo release after v1.19.1 exists on 2026-11-27: tags tempo/v1.19.2, v1.19.2-rc.1, v1.19.3, v1.20.0 and its rc tags return 404, download.tempo.xyz/binaries lists v1.19.1 as newest, and the endpoint answers tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748. tempo main still pins evm2 7c9f3b6d and ruint 1.21.1, and evm2 main is byte identical to cycle 29's crawl. The binary reruns wait for the T15 release.

Still no tagged release past v1.19.1, so the reruns on a release that pins evm2 7c9f3b6d cannot run. On v1.19.1 this cycle reran battery.py, targeted.py, pmdiff.py, pmdiff2.py, swaps.py and replay.py with no difference beyond the known gas-cut scripts, and the pins on tempo main are unchanged.
